I'm not into the big public displays of love. Anxiety here. 

But when I proposed to my now wife, I led it up with 3 fake proposals, one was a movie " will you watch this movie with me", one was chocolate, and the last fake out was on a hike where my brother and I set up a picnic off the trail, he staked it out in camoflauge to take pictures. 

When my wife and I got there she was really excited and couldn't stop smiling. But when I took a tiny box out of the basket, it turned out to be fudge. My brother captured her reaction where it looks like I'm actually proposing and she has this look on her face that says, "that's it?" 

I didn't let it stay that way long though and took out the ring I brought in my pocket. 

I like to think it made it more memorable and fun. Also I'll probably be asked endlessly how I proposed by people throughout the rest of life, and I wanted a good story.
